provenance: Source-informed regional replication, not a blind nationwide search or an independently surveyed microphone location.
Pinned, checksum-verified DOPPLERGEIST reference-region.parquet derived from ADSB.lol for September 8, 2026; all source aircraft retained.
Observed ridge points were selected from the downloaded raw recording before fitting historical flight predictions.
Compatible ECEF positions, DEM plus EGM96 geoid and an assumed 3m microphone height; per-point source datum flags retained by importer.
Piecewise linear position/velocity model. Imported source velocity columns are retained in provenance but are not used by this baseline.
Shared clock and separate emitted-tone sweeps. No independent event-2 shift and no extrapolation across track gaps.
Coarse speed and slant bounds from the guide; 10s separation tolerance and trace-RMSE scoring are explicit reconstruction choices.
Silence rejection is disabled until archive completeness and acoustic detectability are validated.
